name: Autumn

description: An oversized handmade crochet shawl, designed to wrap you in warmth and effortless elegance.

Its generous 2-metre wingspan makes it perfect for wrapping around your shoulders on chilly days, layering over winter outfits or snuggling up on a cold evening.

closing: More than a shawl, it's a warm embrace you can wear.
